-- ofertas por estado
SELECT status, count(*) FROM offers WHERE request_id = 'eaa99dc5-be04-4c24-9bcf-f5065d4bccc9' GROUP BY status ORDER BY status
ACEPTADA|1
CANCELADA|49

-- eventos TripAssigned
SELECT count(*) FROM outbox WHERE type = 'TripAssigned' AND payload->>'solicitudId' = 'eaa99dc5-be04-4c24-9bcf-f5065d4bccc9'

-- la solicitud después de cancelar
